ticket lifecycle/cascade chronology consumed as domain-specific semantics
Task/Objective plan, execution, review and correction chronology
communication chronology, coverage, orphan timers and purge records

consumed_by.reason: shared temporal, audit, transaction, history and projection rules

runtime_dependency_rule: HLD-14 shared services/interfaces must not import domain-module implementations. Domain modules depend on shared temporal/audit/transaction abstractions and supply domain-specific event/action data through explicit interfaces; design_inputs_only are semantic constraints, not reverse runtime dependencies.
forbidden_dependencies: No domain may use UI display timezone or local rendering as persistence chronology authority.
No domain may use audit recording time as substitute for independently supported occurrence/effective time.
No projection/cache may become a write-side source of truth or authorize identity/lifecycle changes.
No correction path may update/delete prior accepted audit/lifecycle evidence when append/supersession authority applies.
No cross-domain workflow may bypass another domain's command validation by writing its tables directly.
